description:
Manage person files in the vault's people directory; people are link targets for note people lists and task assignees, never threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files; open people only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show a single person file
  new [--name NAME] [--category professional|personal|voluntary] — create a person file (INTERACTIVE prompt for any field not supplied)
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  list: QUERY is an optional fuzzy search that ranks results by similarity; --all includes closed people; --json JSON output.
  show: PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md; --json JSON output.
  new: --name full name; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary.
  delete: -y skips the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any field left unspecified. Always pass both --name and --category.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given; the deletion is permanent.
  A person file must exist before `tasks set-assignee` will accept that name.
